svg.text: How temperature, top-k, top-p, and beam search turn raw logits into generated text
The model outputs one logit per vocabulary token.
Softmax converts them to probabilities summing to 1.
Softmax preserves token ranking - it only controls
how peaked the distribution is (see panel 3).
Greedy picks the single best token at each step; beam
search keeps the k best partial sequences.
Winner: 'The cat sat' scores -0.5 vs greedy -1.02
Greedy is beam search with width 1
Beam search suits translation and summarization. For
open-ended chat it tends to produce generic text.
Temperature rescales logits before softmax. Low T
sharpens toward greedy; high T flattens toward uniform.
T approaching 0 becomes greedy decoding. T above 1.5
rarely helps - tail tokens derail coherence.
Truncation removes the unreliable tail before sampling.
top-k keeps a fixed count; top-p adapts to the distribution.
Labels show cumulative probability mass. Gray = discarded.
After truncation the kept probabilities are renormalized
to sum to 1, then one token is sampled.
Simple and fast, but blind to shape: a flat distribution
keeps junk tokens, a peaked one wastes candidates.
Keeps the smallest set covering mass p. Adapts to model
min-p: floor at min_p times p_max
Scales the cutoff with confidence. Robust at high
Apply filters after temperature scaling, before sampling.
Every output token costs one forward pass. Sampling
parameters are applied to logits before each draw.
Cost: one forward pass per generated token - the
KV-cache reuses past keys and values.
Replace sampling with argmax in step 5 and this loop
Tune temperature first, then top-p. Add a repetition
penalty only when loops appear in long outputs.
Divides the logit of any token already in context.
Grows with each occurrence - curbs repeated words.
Flat penalty once seen - encourages new topics.
Temperature and truncation multiply: a low top-p with
high temperature still samples from a narrow set. High
temperature works best with min-p or top-p of 0.95+.
Defaults used by most chat apps: T = 0.7, top-p = 0.9.
